column1: # CHANNELS.tsv -- which TAG each published channel currently points at. Append-only.
# THE CHANNEL IS A POINTER, NOT A VERSION SUFFIX, and that is forced rather than chosen:
# Archipelago calls tuplize_version() on archipelago.json's world_version when it loads an apworld,
# and that raises on any prerelease form ('0.1.0-beta.5' -> ValueError). A suffix would be a
# load-time crash, not a label. So the apworld keeps a strict X.Y.Z world_version, the RELEASE
# carries the -beta.N tag, and a channel names one tag.
# Promotion is a new ROW, never an edit: "when did stable last move, and to what" is a question
# somebody will ask after a bad release, and an overwritten cell cannot answer it.
# EVERY BLOODBORNE RELEASE WAS A GITHUB PRERELEASE UNTIL v0.1.0.0; V.R.M.F tags publish as normal
# latest releases. The ledger remains the pointer regardless: the site resolves a channel by this
# file, not by GitHub's prerelease flag -- the flag is UI. Draft releases stay excluded. See
# Website label: `beta -> main` is the Development channel. There is no rolling `dev` release for
# Bloodborne yet, so the Development block on /downloads stays hidden until there is one.
